title: UKMTO confirms three vessels struck in Strait of Hormuz
excerpt: UKMTO has confirmed that three vessels were struck in the Strait of Hormuz on 29 September, with other reports describing four vessels hit in 24 hours.
x_post: UKMTO confirms three vessels were struck in the Strait of Hormuz on 29 September, with reports of four hit in 24 hours. #MaritimeSecurity #StraitOfHormuz #Seafarers #UKMTO
